ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ
en: (1) For the accustomed security of the Quraysh[1996] -
enNotes: [1996]- i.e., the honor and reputation Allāh had given them as guardians of the Holy Kaʿbah, which allowed them to travel without fear of being harmed.

en: (2) Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer[1997] -
enNotes: [1997]- i.e., the trading caravans that traveled south in winter and north in summer.

en: (3) Let them worship the Lord of this House,[1998]

ar: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
en: (4) Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
tr: Al-ladhī aṭʿamahum min jūʿiw waʾāmanahum min khawf
